============================================================================
OmniBuf-PHP Benchmark Suite (PHP 8.6.0 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: 11-field PeerUpdate (365B OmniBuf, 341B Protobuf) + >16 KiB stress cases
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (ext-omnibuf) | 284 ns | 3,522,775 | 365 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 4,609 ns | 216,985 | 365 | 16.23x slower |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 11,204 ns | 89,252 | 365 | 39.45x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 440 ns | 2,274,037 | 341 | 1.55x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 87,169 ns | 11,472 | 341 | 306.93x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 1,412 ns | 708,061 | 803 | 4.97x slower |

### 2. Full Message Decode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (ext-omnibuf) | 966 ns | 1,035,602 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 16,124 ns | 62,018 | 16.69x slower |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 27,852 ns | 35,905 | 28.83x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 4,022 ns | 248,623 | 4.16x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 50,069 ns | 19,973 | 51.83x slower |
| json_decode (stdlib) | 4,560 ns | 219,314 | 4.72x slower |

### 3. Read a Single Nested Field

### 5. Large Embedded Message Encode

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (ext-omnibuf) | 2,927 ns | 341,655 | 39255 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 8,713 ns | 114,771 | 39255 | 2.98x slower |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 18,309 ns | 54,619 | 39255 | 6.26x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 2,161 ns | 462,821 | 39227 | 1.35x faster |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,162,229 ns | 860 | 39227 | 397.07x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 23,523 ns | 42,511 | 39681 | 8.04x slower |

### 6. Embedded Message Growth

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (ext-omnibuf) | 2,425 ns | 412,426 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 10,960 ns | 91,239 | 4.52x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 6,370 ns | 156,992 | 2.63x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,141,449 ns | 876 | 470.70x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 30,960 ns | 32,300 | 12.77x slower |
